name: r6i_MessagePageStep
notes: one frame of a message page: fade in showing the selected item text half way; wait for a button (replay voice in mode 2; close on second mask or mode 5 queueing page 2 with sound 0x397); fade out releasing the texture and tail-call the queued page through the table at 0x002DDAE0; modern cl stores the constant 20.0f as an immediate instead of loading it from .rdata (same value)

name: r6i_StatusPageStep
notes: one frame of the status screen page: fade in and show the entry text (calls 0x00065DB0 with EDX=entry and 0x00065E50 with ESI=1/0); wait for a button then queue page 0/4 or go to the icon screen; fade out and tail-call 0x00065AC0; icon screen fade out releases the resource and shows the icon; step 0x12 tail-calls 0x00065AA0; modern cl stores the float constants 15.0 and 20.0 as immediates instead of loading them from .rdata (same values)

name: r6i_BookPageStep
notes: one frame of the picture-book page: fade in over 30 frames; turn pages with held directions or the first button (sound 0x384); close on the last page or the second button queueing the return page; fade out and release the four page textures at 0x003E6528; modern cl stores 15.0/30.0 as immediates instead of loading them from .rdata (same values) and merges the byte stores page[5]=4 and page[6]=1 into one word store (0x104)

name: r6i_ResultsPageStep
notes: one frame of the results page: mark sprites 9/10 and start the 30-frame timer; reveal one row every 15 frames (sound 0x38C) up to nine; close on the second button or button 0x100 in mode 1 (fade out; phase 3; queue page 5 or 0; sound 2); modern cl merges the four queued page byte stores at 0x00428F84 into one dword store (same idiom as r6g_ReturnToTitle) and stores 30.0 as an immediate and pushes the float argument 8.0 from .rdata (same values)

name: r6i_ResultsPopupStep
notes: one frame of the results popup while 0x00429820 is set: wait for the first button; fade in over 30 frames; wait; fade out and return to state 1 (setting 0x004297FC on page step 3); modern cl stores 30.0 as an immediate instead of loading it from .rdata (same value)

name: r6i_TitleReleaseTextures
notes: reset the two title scales to 1.0 and release the textures loaded for the current title phase (background plus handles 0..15 of 0x003E68B8 by phase; phase 0 keeps them when the queued page is 4); modern cl stores 1.0f as an immediate instead of loading it from .rdata (same value)

name: r6i_PressStartStep
notes: one frame of the press-start page: wait for either button and queue page 4 step 0x10 (sound 2); fade in over 30 frames; fade out then wait for the record count and release the title textures (0x0006E490) and take the queued page bytes and tail-call 0x0006DD40; modern cl merges the four queued page byte stores 4/0/0x10/0 into one dword store 0x00100004 (in image range so listed as data; same idiom as r6g_ReturnToTitle) and stores 30.0 as an immediate (same value)

name: r6i_NoticePageStep
notes: one frame of a notice page: wait for the second button and queue page 3 step 0x60 (sound 2); fade in over 30 frames; fade out and set the page phase 0x00428F20 to 3; modern cl merges the four queued page byte stores 3/0/0x60/0 into one dword store 0x00600003 (same idiom as r6g_ReturnToTitle) and stores 30.0 as an immediate (same value)

name: r6i_TitleLettersAnim
notes: move the five title letters between key poses along a cubic Bezier (0x00071FE0) with an eased parameter (sin based over 110 frames) and interpolate their scales; mode 1 uses the to-key control points in order and mode 2 the from-key control points reversed; clear the mode when the timer runs out then step it; modern cl builds the constant 1.0 with fld1 instead of loading it from .rdata (same value)

name: r6i_ResultsBannerStep
notes: animate the results banner while 0x004297FC is set: mark sprites 9/10 and start a 30-frame timer at scale 2; fade in over the first 6 frames; slide (timer*8.53 and timer*-17.07); at the end unmark the sprites and restart the rows and play sound 0x38B with a 90-frame timer; then shrink the scale from 1+timer/24 to 1; pad polled but unused; modern cl stores the float constants 1.0/2.0/90.0 as immediates instead of loading them from .rdata (same values)

name: r6i_KeyDoorStep
notes: one step of a key door (actor 0..3 with event flag 0x17/0x19/0x1A/0x18 and sound flag 0x1F4..0x1F7): mode 0 clears and mode 1 arms (phase 10) and mode 3 forces phase 0x14; phase 10 opens or keeps the door shut then goes to 0x14; phase 0x14 clears and returns 0; else 1; regargs: mode=EAX st=ESI idx=EDI

name: r6i_KeyDoorStep2
notes: the key door step of 0x000B34F0 for the second set of doors (event flags 0x13..0x16 and sound flags 0x1F0..0x1F3); regargs: mode=EAX st=ESI idx=EDI

name: r6i_RoomScriptFade
notes: room script: fade out and wait; set actor 0 flags 0x300000 and player flags 0x3800008 and fade back in; wait; give actor 0 motion 1; after 1.5 seconds clear the actor flags; phase 0x63 clears the state and returns 0; float to int truncation written with R6I_FTOI (cvttss2si like the original); modern cl pushes the float argument 0.5 from .rdata instead of as an immediate (same value)

name: r6i_RoomScriptTimed
notes: room script with timed steps: reset actor 0x18; after 3 s give actor 0x1A motion 1; after 0.5 s switch actor 0x18 on; after 0.8 s motion 2; when the motion ends motion 0 and phase 0x14 which clears the state and returns 0; the time tests are !(fps*k > count) in double precision like the original

name: r6i_RoomScriptFade2
notes: room script like 0x000BACA0 for actor 1: set player flags 0x3800008 and fade out; wait; set actor 1 flags 0x300000 and fade in; wait; give actor 1 motion 1; after 6 seconds clear the flags; phase 0x63 clears the state and returns 0; float to int truncation written with R6I_FTOI (cvttss2si like the original); modern cl pushes the float argument 0.5 from .rdata instead of as an immediate (same value)

name: r6i_RoomScript2E2
notes: room cutscene script for event flag 0x2E2: finish at once when set or open actor 2; wait for a free player; timed camera event 3 with player stop and camera moves; give actor 3 motion 1; restore camera and player; wait for pair 0 state 3; after 5 s set the flag; phase 0x14 clears the state and returns 0

name: r6i_RoomScript2E3
notes: follow-up room script for event flag 0x2E3 like 0x000B89B0 for actors 4 and 5: also waits for flag 0x2E2; camera move 0x0001AB00(3 2 1 1); waits for pair 0 state 4 and sets 0x003ED23C to 2; after 5 s sets flag 0x2E3; phase 0x14 clears the state and returns 0

name: r6i_RoomScript2E4
notes: last room script of the set for event flag 0x2E4 like 0x000B8C60 for actors 6 and 7 (waits for flag 0x2E3; camera move 0x0001AB00(3 2 2 1)); phase 15 restores camera and player and sets flag 0x2E4 and goes to 0x14; phase 0x14 clears the state and returns 0

name: r6i_RoomScriptC2
notes: room script for chapter 2 stages 7/8/11: phase 0 checks chapter and stage (assert-style hangs) and on stage 8 clears flag bit 1 and sets actor 1 motion 2 (event flag 0xF set) or resets it; phase 8 starts camera event 3 and actor 1 motion 1; phase 9 waits and ends it; phase 0x14 clears flags and sets phase 0x63 and returns 0
